finding: No verified treatment variable has been established by the current analysis
Customer eligibility for specific campaigns has not been verified
Campaign membership alone does not prove actual customer exposure
Campaign type is a descriptive characteristic unless its intervention meaning is established
redemption_status records observed redemption and is a candidate outcome
A defensible treatment contrast has not yet been established
Differences in observed redemption rates do not independently establish causal effects
Treatment assignment and causal identification require further investigation
